basic_info.description: Charming and light-filled, 339 Jersey is a 2BD/2BA + office/den full-floor residence in a beautiful 2-unit Victorian just one block from 24th Street. Spanning 1,283 SF (per graphic artist), the home features a spacious living room with bay windows, a generous kitchen/dining area, and a flexible office/den that opens to a private deck and shared yardperfect for working from home or effortless entertaining. Two well-separated bedrooms offer privacy and comfort. Additional perks include in-unit laundry, exclusive-use storage, and 1-car garage parking. Period details like high ceilings and hardwood floors pair seamlessly with modern updates to create a warm, inviting atmosphere. 341 Jersey is also available, and the entire building may be purchased togetheroffering a rare opportunity for fast-track condo conversion (buyer to verify). Prime Noe Valley location with a 97 Walk Scoreclose to Whole Foods, parks, boutiques, restaurants, and tech shuttles. Two blocks to MUNI, J light rail, and easy freeway access.
